title: Cloud toolchain target — Buck2 build/test authority + temporary GitHub lane unlocker + native oya-ci cutover
purpose: Consolidated target for the build + CI/CD + verify toolchain overhaul. Buck2 is the build/test/check authority for active lanes; Cargo metadata can feed generated Buck2 graphs and local Cargo mutation output remains advisory in a dual-build setup. GitHub/GitHub Actions is a temporary SCM/CI lane unlocker under ADR-0516, not the permanent destination. The destination is native Oyatie SCM plus rust-prow/oya-ci/cloud-workspace/release-conveyor seams with Buck2 evidence. Honest non-claim: target spec; no native controller, remote execution/cache, release conveyor, or live cutover is implemented here.

build_graph.system: Buck2 rust rules and checked-in BUCK targets are canonical for CI/build/test/check lanes.
build_graph.dependency_ssot: Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock may remain the Rust dependency metadata source for reindeer-style Buck2 graph generation; generated BUCK output is reviewed and Buck2 remains authority.
build_graph.remote: remote build execution + hermetic remote cache are native-toolchain targets; the bridge must not require a non-native external CI/CD substrate.
build_graph.affected_targets: Buck2 owner/reverse-dependency affected-target selection for presubmit; avoid full-workspace rebuild on small changes except at serialized fan-in gates.
build_graph.incremental: no incremental compilation in CI (from-scratch + remote cache); incremental local only

ci.orchestrator: ADR-0516 temporary GitHub Actions bridge now; native rust-prow/oya-ci is the destination once SCM/CI/CD/cloud workspace seams are ready.
ci.config: pointer-thin reusable workflow during the bridge; native cutover uses short-lived workload identity, tightly scoped secrets, isolated pipelines, and Kubernetes-native elastic agents.
ci.pr_gating: branch protection requires github-lane-unlocker-required during the bridge; native cutover replaces it with source-bound oya-ci-required after evidence.
ci.test_runner: Buck2 test targets and Buck2-native LLVM source-based coverage are merge authority; Cargo/nextest may remain local advisory only where the dual-build strategy is intentionally maintained.
ci.local_dev: Buck2 affected/full targets for shift-left; Cargo commands are advisory and must not become protected-branch authority.

oya_overlay.role: governance/verify orchestrator; delegates build/test/check to Buck2 and runs bespoke governance gates.
oya_overlay.retires: duplicated Cargo mirror authority and manual required-status bridges; affected-scope default plus serialized fan-in evidence.

merge_and_delivery.merge_queue: speculative + batch (ADR-0111): test A vs main, B vs main+A, ...; always-green trunk
merge_and_delivery.progressive_delivery: native release conveyor target: canary -> bake-time SLO observation -> automatic metric-gated rollback; cosign-verified images (ADR-0181).

non_claims: Target spec only; no native SCM/CI/CD cutover, remote execution/cache, release conveyor, or migration executed.
GitHub/GitHub Actions remains temporary bridge authority only and must not be treated as the permanent destination.
No CI-throughput/cache-hit/SLO measurement; all parity/performance claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
